Copying in details on DB sequencing. Notes below are technical and should be pasted into the runbook.

Planned DB cutover sequence (short form)
1) Freeze writes to secondary shard at T0.
2) Take quick consistent snapshot (approx 3–7 min). Snapshot will be stored in S3 with lifecycle tag.
3) Promote secondary to primary and warm caches — expected 8–12 min.
4) Re-point application pool (canary) to new primary; monitor write path.

Estimated timings: total expected switch 15–25 minutes. Restore RTO to pre-cutover snapshot (if needed) is ~12–20 minutes depending on replication lag. We can put an upper SLA of 30 minutes to be conservative.

Fallback specifics
- If any of the Datadog SLOs breach (error rate > 1.5% or p50 latency > 350ms for 5m), trigger immediate rollback: re-route traffic to blue pool and restore snapshot.
- Snapshot restore playbook: run `aws rds restore-db-instance-from-s3 --source-snapshot <id>` (runbook will have exact IDs).

I'll attach a trimmed runbook with the commands for DC ops. Karthik has the files attached here: runbook_cutover.md (internal draft).

Karthik
Sr. Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
